title: Be ready for AI-agent checkout and tight PC supply this holiday
summary: Tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3 to 32M (Omdia); notebooks stay weak through Q2 2027 (DigiTimes). ChatGPT Wallet lets agents pay at checkouts; Klarna joined Adyen agentic suite; Walmart US e-commerce +23%; Amex sees 14-year high SMB holiday spend.

points.headline: AI agents are gaining the ability to pay, so checkout must be agent-ready
points.detail: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for agent purchases at retailer checkouts, and Klarna is now in Adyen’s agentic suite. We should test our store checkout for agent-initiated orders and payment options.

points.headline: Retailers’ AI assistants are starting to show sales impact
points.detail: Target’s Ask Target assistant shows an early sales lift in beta. Assistants on big retail channels will shape electronics discovery; we should plan for being surfaced in them.

points.headline: PC and tablet supply stays tight into 2027
points.detail: Tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3, notebooks stay weak through Q2 2027 and the PCB shortage lasts to mid-2028. Expect firmer pricing and tighter stock; we should plan promotions and inventory accordingly.

points.headline: Walmart speed and small-business holiday budgets set the demand picture
points.detail: Walmart U.S. e-commerce grew 23% on fulfillment speed, and Amex projects a 14-year high in small-business holiday spending. We should push fast delivery and business bundles and financing.
